description: The latching relay form identifies an operating element whose mechanism retains a documented state. Its reset or release representation completes the circuit-reading sequence; removing the initiating command may not restore the initial position.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
